messages:
asha: Quick postmortem update for Kestrel Systems VPC peering flap — root cause looks like an on-prem firewall rule change + an isolation bug in the peering reconciliation path. Impact: intermittent calls to dedicated instances failed for ~22m, ~15% request loss for that customer. Rolling action items below, need owners and dates.
ben: thanks — can you paste the key logs/error we saw?
asha: paste of logs: ```Mar 28 09:12:33 peering-sync ERROR: conn_attempt failed: ECONNRESET from 10.1.2.45
Mar 28 09:12:33 peering-sync WARN: reconciliation skipped due to missing route for vpc-ks-01
Mar 28 09:14:01 proxy ERROR: isolation-check failed: unexpected tenant ID mismatch
```
carlos: that isolation-check mismatch is the suspicious bit. I've repro'd the mismatch locally when the cloud route update is delayed. Looks like code path assumes eventual consistency and skips rebind.
lisa: recurring pattern: we've seen similar onprem peering flaps in 3 customers in last 6mo where onprem network changes + reconcilers race. Suggest two-pronged approach: (1) short-term operator playbook + automated rollback on route loss (2) medium-term fix in peering reconciler to verify tenant mapping before marking healthy.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0428-KSTL-PEER. Severity: Sev2. Notified: eng-oncall, eng-platform, customer-success.
asha: proposed action items (short):
- A1: hotfix: add conservative backoff + immediate rollback when route disappears (owner: @ben) due 2026-04-29
- A2: postmortem writeup + customer comms (owner: @lisa) due 2026-04-30
- A3: runbook entry for onprem peering changes; checklist for CS/SE (owner: @carlos) due 2026-05-03
- A4: deeper reconciler fix (owner: eng-platform / ben + carlos) ETA: 2 sprints (target 2026-05-15)
- A5: add telemetry alert for tenant-mismatch rate > 0.1% (owner: eng-sre) due 2026-04-30
ben: I'll own A1. I'll push a small patch to avoid marking routes healthy until verification succeeds 2x in a row. PR target today, deploy to staging.
carlos: I'll start A3 — will draft runbook and a pre-change checklist for onprem peering updates; will sync w/ CS to test it.
lisa: I'll own A2. I'll draft customer note that explains mitigation and timeline; flag any compensation needs if they ask.
asha: for A4 we should pair ben + carlos. Ben, can you estimate a rough scope?
ben: rough: ~3-5d dev + 1d testing + 1d rollout. If we include additional integration tests for simulated delayed route propagation maybe +2d. So 2 sprints safe.
lisa: also flagging recurring pattern for PM — might need policy change: require CS to notify infra 1h before large onprem network maintenance.
carlos: noted. I'll add that to runbook and open a small docs PR.
asha: blockers?
ben: none yet. need test harness for injecting route flaps in staging — pinging eng-infra.
asha: ok I'll spin up a runbook task and link the incident. Please update INC ticket with PR links and status. 
incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem template due in 72h.
lisa: pinging @carlos for a quick sync at 10:30 to review runbook outline.
carlos: 10:30 works.
asha: thanks all — I'll follow up in 24h with a single-threaded checklist and owners column. :white_check_mark:
